evidence.detail: The renderer exits unless Client.cH equals rs/n/c/j.c; R5 already resolves rs/n/c/j as BloodDiamondFuserInterface from the exact title 'Blood Diamond Fuser' and the text 'Fuse items to sacrifice them into blood diamonds!'.
Client constructs exactly one rs/l/c/a instance into its live field y during startup, and the main rendering path invokes that instance's render method every frame.
A live Client decode path for selector/value 13 parses exactly four comma-separated integers and forwards them to rs/l/c/a.a(int,int,int,int), populating one of three runtime fuser entries.

The overlay resolves each populated entry's item id through rs/d/k.a(...), lazily builds the item sprite and draws it at one of the three fixed Blood Diamond Fuser slot positions, together with quantity/value text using Client.g(int).
The class hardcodes exactly three two-point slot coordinate pairs and uses the same centered/fixed-mode offsets as the Blood Diamond Fuser screen; it does not render on any other interface.

candidates.note: BloodDiamondFuserOverlay is fixed by the already-reviewed BloodDiamondFuserInterface identity, exclusive interface-root guard, live Client ownership, exact three-slot geometry and packet-fed item rendering. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: rs/l/c/c is a four-field runtime entry with one cached item sprite plus three integers; its constructor accepts three integers and the owning BloodDiamondFuserOverlay is its only exact consumer.
The overlay uses entry.b() as the item-definition id passed to rs/d/k.a(...), then caches the resulting item sprite back onto the entry.

The overlay uses the remaining two integer getters as the two numeric display values rendered beside the item slot, with one value controlling item-quantity display and the other rendered against the shared Blood Diamond/Fuser presentation sprite.
The live Client packet/value-13 path supplies these entry values directly from a four-integer comma-separated payload before the overlay renders them on BloodDiamondFuserInterface.

candidates.note: BloodDiamondFuserItemEntry is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the fuser overlay's item-id/sprite/two-value runtime slot record. The broader entry role is exact; the two numeric subroles remain intentionally unnamed. Confidence is 0.997.
